title: The Mapmaker's Rain
logline: A mapmaker brings water to a drought-stricken town, then discovers that erasing ink cannot undo a flood or silence another author.
central_conflict: A mapmaker brings water to a drought-stricken town, then discovers that erasing ink cannot undo a flood or silence another author.
theme: A well-meant attempt to help carries a cost that forces a more difficult choice.

characters.name: Nia
characters.personality: Resourceful, emotionally invested, prepared to risk a clear cost.
characters.desire: Use the inherited map to bring the town safe drinking water.
characters.flaw: She wants to rescue everyone to undo the guilt of losing her mother.
characters.voice_direction: Natural and specific; composed intent turns to alarm through the consequences.

characters.name: Tavi
characters.personality: A distinct counterpart with a practical objective, not a generic warning voice.
characters.desire: Bring water to the family street without losing the town bridge.
characters.flaw: Trusts procedure or immediate appearances before testing the implication.
characters.voice_direction: Clearly different timbre; measured, then personally unsettled by evidence.

environments.description: A mapmaker brings water to a drought-stricken town, then discovers that erasing ink cannot undo a flood or silence another author. A readable, original setting with visible cause and effect.

map_rule.statement: Lines drawn on the inherited map can alter the town landscape.

mother_lost.statement: Nia mother was lost in a river and has been presumed dead.

central.question: Is her mother alive, and why is the other pen steering water toward home?
central.writer_only_answer: Her mother is trapped on the counterpart map; she is trying to join the two landscapes to escape, unaware that each rescue stroke floods the town.

season_arc.goal: Use the inherited map to bring the town safe drinking water.
season_arc.conflict: A mapmaker brings water to a drought-stricken town, then discovers that erasing ink cannot undo a flood or silence another author.
season_arc.turn: Nia recognizes her presumed-dead mother handwriting in marks she did not make.
season_arc.payoff: The first method fails and exposes the larger problem.

season_arc.goal: Stop the flood while finding who holds the second pen.
season_arc.conflict: Nia can protect the town by erasing the path to her home, but the handwriting begs her to keep that route open.
season_arc.turn: The second map shows a mother waiting in a dry copy of the riverbed, where every rescue stroke creates water in Nia town.
season_arc.payoff: Tavi evacuates the street while Nia tests a small shared landmark and confirms that someone can answer her.

season_arc.goal: Bring her mother home without flooding the town.
season_arc.conflict: Joining the maps at the house would drown the inhabited street; the only safe meeting point is the abandoned quarry, and the old map must be torn to move it.
season_arc.turn: Her mother survived in the counterpart map, unaware that each attempt to draw an escape flooded the real town.
season_arc.payoff: Nia gives up the inherited intact map and the fantasy of effortless rescue; she and Tavi create a safe crossing at the cost of its power.
